## Cloud Dragon, Juvenile (CR 10)

**XP** 9,600  
 CN Large dragon (air)  
 **Init** +4; **Senses** dragon senses, mist vision; Perception +19; **Aura** frightful presence (120 ft., DC 19)  

**Defense**

 **AC** 23, touch 9, flat-footed 23 (+14 natural, –1 size)  
 **hp** 126 (12d12+48)  
 **Fort** +12, **Ref** +8, **Will** +12  
 **Immune** electricity, paralysis, sleep  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 40 ft., fly 200 ft. (poor), swim 40 ft.  
 **Melee** bite +16 (2d6+7), 2 claws +17 (1d8+5), tail slap +14 (1d8+7), 2 wings +14 (1d6+2)  
 **Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 5 ft. (10 ft. with bite)  
 **Special Attacks** breath weapon (40-ft. cone, 8d8 electricity, DC 20)  
 **Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 12th; concentration +15)  

 At will—*[fog cloud](../../magic/spells/fog-cloud.md)*, *[obscuring mist](../../magic/spells/obscuring-mist.md)*  

 **Spells Known** (CL 1st; concentration +4)  

  1st (4/day)—*[charm person](../../magic/spells/charm-person.md)* (DC 14), *[detect secret doors](../../magic/spells/detect-secret-doors.md)*  
 0 (at will)—*[dancing lights](../../magic/spells/dancing-lights.md)*, *[light](../../magic/spells/light.md)*, *[message](../../magic/spells/message.md)*, *[read magic](../../magic/spells/read-magic.md)*  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 20, **Dex** 11, **Con** 19, **Int** 14, **Wis** 18, **Cha** 17  
 **Base Atk** +12; **CMB** +18; **CMD** 28 (32 vs. trip)  
 **Feats** Critical Focus, Dazzling Display, Multiattack, Skill Focus (Diplomacy), Weapon Focus (claws), [Improved Initiative](../../rules/feats/improved-initiative.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Improved Initiative.*  
 **Skills** Appraise +17, Diplomacy +24, Fly +9, Intimidate +18, Knowledge (planes) +17, Perception +19, Sense Motive +19, Stealth +11, Swim +13; **Racial Modifiers** +8 Swim  
 **Languages** Auran, Common, Draconic  

**Special Abilities**

 **Mist Vision (Su)** A cloud dragon can see through fog, clouds, and similar obscuring effects with perfect clarity.  
  

**Ecology**

**Environment** any sky (Plane of Air)  
 **Organization** solitary  
 **Treasure** triple
